candidates.change_summary: Change constructor argument from msg.sender to address(this) so the EmergencyOracle is created with owner = C contract instead of the calling admin.
Emit event with the contract (C) as the owner instead of msg.sender, making the observable event owner field differ.
Increment isAdmin[msg.sender] to false after creating the oracle, potentially changing future admin checks and thus observable behavior across calls.
Swap order: emit event before constructing the EmergencyOracle, so the event may reference an address(0) (or invalid oracle) instead of the actual new instance.
